thread:
maria_marketing: Quick pulse — putting together the KPI snapshot from last week's launch posts + webinar. Can we get final numbers for MQLs, CTR, pipeline contribution by EOD?

olivia_analytics: Got preliminary table. MQLs: 312 (webinar 160, blog 82, social 70). CTR across launch posts 2.1%. Pipeline influenced est $420k. I'll push a slide to the drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-q2

sam_growth: Nice. Any sign of routing lag? inbound SLAs tripped yesterday.

rita_ops: Yep, saw ~18% delay on SFDC ingestion between 11:00-13:00 UTC — likely API throttling. Fix queued with eng-sre.

jon_product: Messaging iteration note — variant B (shorter CTAs) outperformed in opens but conversion flat.

maria_marketing: Can we break down conversion by variant + landing? need for A/B readout in Friday review.

olivia_analytics: Will add variant breakdown. Also flag: attribution windows changed in GA -> we're losing last-touch on some webinar registrants. Recommend switching to a 28-day window for cohort attribution.

sam_growth: If we expand window, does pipeline attribution change materially?

olivia_analytics: +48% credit to webinar vs previous 7-day window. I'll include a sensitivity table.

maria_marketing: Great. @deploy_bot any updates on the SFDC ingestion fix?

deploy_bot: incident created #eng-sre-4282. Hotfix deploying now. ETA ~30m :hourglass: 

jon_product: For Friday KPI review, can we get a concise slide: top 3 wins, top 3 risks (routing, attribution window, messaging lift). Who owns slides?

sam_growth: I'll own metrics slide. @maria_marketing owns narrative. @olivia_analytics visuals.

maria_marketing: Added to calendar slot. Thanks all. Small ask: add a one-slide appendix with raw cohort numbers for auditors.

olivia_analytics: Appendix ready — will drop link once deploy finishes and ingestion reconciles. Quick SQL I used for cohort counts:

```
SELECT cohort_date, source, COUNT(*) as registrants
FROM webinar_registrations
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY cohort_date DESC;
```

rita_ops: Noted. I'll follow up post-deploy for ingestion verification.

sam_growth: Perfect. See you at Friday 9am PT. :thumbsup:
